about: What this file is: the shot check for the Works' view W1 (No. 1's gate) (paper-film/blender/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/assemble_works.py, plan 34 part 1 'A. The Works'): which objects make up each prop and figure, their parts in the story, the lane's direction, where the typed words go. Each waiting man is his own group, so the checker counts them and draws their outlines (solo/NAME.png). Used by paper-film/blender/shot_facts.py and paper-film/tools/check_shot.py; run from the kit's top folder with BLEND=assets/models/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/works-lane.blend paper-film/tools/check-shot.sh paper-film/blender/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/assemble_works.py THIS_FILE OUT [PICTURE] -- --view w1.
subject: no-1 gate
story_reaches_down_note: rule 7 (round 5): some story prop or the subject must reach at least this far down the frame, so the story fills the frame into its lower part (the notice corner's drum, chair and pail fill 0.45 to 0.8 down); checked only where a check file gives it
man_2_note: Round 5, man 2 (the stooped man): round 4's first problem in W1 and W3, 'man 2 rests on brazier, not on the ground (Blender x -5.42, y 21.14)', was a false alarm caused by his reach, not his feet. The checker casts five rays down from 5 cm above his lowest point, at the middle and the four quarter points of his outline box; stooping over the brazier with his arms held out, his box reached over its rim, and the quarter-point ray at Blender x -5.16, y 21.40 started 0.22 m from the brazier's middle, inside its rim, and met the drum's floor (worked out from round 4's measurements). His feet stood on the pavement. In round 5 he warms his hands at the brazier against the right gate leaf, turned 40 degrees, and the checker finds him standing on the ground; he overlaps the brazier by 41 pixels across on the film's frame from W1's composed spot.
